lines.text: The priests, the temple guard captain and the Sadducees seized Peter and John and held them until the next day.
Many who heard the message believed, and the number of men grew to about three thousand.
Filled with the Holy Spirit, Peter told the rulers they crucified the man whom God raised from the dead.
The council noted the two had been with Gamaliel, and seeing the healed man, had nothing to say.
The believers asked for complete boldness to speak God's word, and after they prayed, their meeting place was shaken.
